notes.title: Burger Patrol - Tiny Patch, Big Buns!
notes.content:
Patrol Squad, we’ve rolled out a delicious little update for your burger-stacking adventures:

🧱 Fixed a sneaky bottom row stacking bug – no more 2x1 burger bricks causing chaos at the base! The burger gods are pleased.

🐶 Dog petting power boosted by 1000x – that’s right. You can now pet your patrol pup with unrelenting enthusiasm. Science can’t explain it, but your dog sure feels it.

Stack ‘em high, pet ‘em hard, and stay greasy out there.

— The Burger Patrol Dev Team

notes.title: Weekly Normal Mode Leaderboards.
notes.content:
We have added a Weekly Leaderboard for Normal mode!
You can now compete weekly from Thursdays at 7PM EST to the following Thursday at 6:59 PM EST.
The results of the previous 3 weeks will also be shown.

Let us know what you think? Should we add weeklies for other modes too?

Thanks as always for being part of Burger Patrol!

notes.title: Hamburger Patch #2 - Expert Mode
notes.content:
Very small patch for the professional Burger Patrol players.
- Added a 7th game mode - Expert mode.
- Added new Leaderboard - Expert Mode Top Score

Expert mode starts players off at 6x drop speed, so only the top members of Burger Patrol need apply.

notes.title: Hamburger Patch #1
notes.content:
Just a small patch to get us started:
- Options selected will now be saved between gameplay sessions.
- Added a small drop speed counter below the bonus fuel meter.
- Fixed a small bottom row bug that occured on long match 4s triggering early.

Happy Burger Making.
